_note: Questions on the home page, also given to Google as FAQPage structured data. Keep answers accurate.

items.question: Which areas of Hyderabad do you cover?
items.answer: We serve homes and businesses across Hyderabad and nearby areas. Share your location when you call or enquire and we'll confirm the visit.

items.question: Which AC brands do you service?
items.answer: All major brands, including Daikin, Voltas, Blue Star, LG, Samsung, Carrier, Hitachi, Mitsubishi, O General, Panasonic, Lloyd and Haier, whichever brand and wherever you bought the unit.

items.question: What are your working hours?
items.answer: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 7pm. You can send an enquiry or WhatsApp message at any time and we'll reply during working hours.

items.question: Do you sell genuine spare parts?
items.answer: Yes. We stock compressors, capacitors, fan motors, PCBs, copper coils, refrigerant gases, filters and remotes. Share your AC's brand and model number and we'll check fit and availability before you buy.

items.question: Do you offer annual maintenance contracts (AMC)?
items.answer: Yes, for homes, offices, shops and commercial sites. An AMC covers scheduled servicing visits so faults are caught early and your system runs efficiently all year.

items.question: Will I get a quote before work starts?
items.answer: Always. A technician inspects the unit, explains the cause and the parts needed, and gives you a clear quote. Work starts only after you agree.
